macros.name: sfgbranch
macros.doc: \sfgbranch{〈dx〉}{〈dy〉}{〈pos〉}{〈text〉} draws a straight sfg branch from (0, 0) to (〈dx〉, 〈dy〉).

macros.name: sfgcurve
macros.doc: \sfgcurve{〈dx〉}{〈dy〉}{〈off 〉}{〈pos〉}{〈text〉} draws a curved sfg path from (0, 0) to (〈dx〉, 〈dy〉).

macros.name: sfgnode
macros.doc: \sfgnode{〈pos〉}{〈text〉} draws a node with label 〈text〉. 〈pos〉 decides where the label is typeset.

macros.name: sfgsetangle
macros.doc: \sfgsetangle{〈an〉} sets the incidence angle of sfgcurves 〈an〉 degrees.

macros.name: sfgsetarrowloc
macros.doc: \sfgsetarrowloc{〈mid 〉} sets the location of the sfgbranch’s arrow.

macros.name: sfgsetlines
macros.doc: \sfgsetlines{〈li_len〉}{〈lii 〉}{〈liii 〉} sets the line thickness \sfg@Li (used for all lines) to 〈li_len〉, the thickness \sfg@Lii (used for terminal nodes) to 〈lii〉 × 〈li_len〉, and the thickness \sfg@Liii to 〈liii〉 × 〈li_len〉.

macros.name: sfgsetsize
macros.doc: \sfgsetsize{〈nr 〉}{〈al 〉}{〈no〉}{〈ao〉} sets the node radius to 〈nr〉 units, the arrowlength to 〈al〉 units, the offset of the nodes’ labels to 〈no〉 units and the offset of the arrows’ labels to 〈ao〉 units.

macros.name: sfgsetunit
macros.doc: \sfgsetunit{〈length〉} sets \unitlength and the PS unit to 〈length〉, and defines the default pstricks linewidth as 0.4 pt.

macros.name: sfgtermnode
macros.doc: \sfgtermnode{〈pos〉}{〈text〉} draws a terminal node (black circle filled white).
